entries.name: CoinIssuer
entries.description: Manages the inflation and minting schedule of the Aztec token. It enforces an annual percentage cap and mints new tokens for the budget.

ASSET.description: AZTEC token minted by this issuer.

entries.name: GovernanceProposer
entries.description: Intermediary contract through which the designated proposer for each L2 slot can signal support for an L1 payload. A signalling round comprises 1000 slots. A payload that receives at least 600 signals can be submitted to the L1 Governance contract within the configured lifetime.

getGovernance.description: Current Registry owner to which successful signalling rounds are submitted.

getInstance.description: Rollup instance whose checkpoint proposers can signal proposals.

GSE.description: Global staking escrow used to validate sequencer voting power.

REGISTRY.description: Registry used to resolve the canonical rollup instance.

ROUND_SIZE.description: Number of slots in one sequencer signalling round.

QUORUM_SIZE.description: Number of signals a payload needs to win a signalling round.

EXECUTION_DELAY_IN_ROUNDS.description: Number of complete rounds after signalling before the winning payload can be submitted to Governance.

LIFETIME_IN_ROUNDS.description: Maximum age of a winning signalling round that can still be submitted to Governance.

entries.name: Governance
entries.description: DAO contract used for proposals and token voting. Heavily interdependent with the GSE for voting power snapshots.

ASSET.description: AZTEC token used for governance deposits and voting power.

governanceProposer.description: Address allowed to create proposals after sequencer signalling succeeds.

entries.name: Registry
entries.description: Central directory that tracks the current 'canonical' (active) Rollup contract address and key system contracts like the Reward Distributor.

getCanonicalRollup.description: The latest registered rollup instance, treated as canonical by the Aztec contracts.

getGovernance.description: The current Registry owner, which controls registration and the Registry-selected reward distributor.

getRewardDistributor.description: The Registry-selected reward distributor. An existing Rollup keeps the distributor fixed at its deployment and is not retargeted when this pointer changes.

numberOfVersions.description: Number of rollup versions registered in the registry.

getVersion.description: Registered rollup version identifiers in insertion order.

entries.name: RewardDistributor
entries.description: Holds tokens allocated for protocol rewards. The canonical Rollup contract, as defined by the Registry, can draw from the implicit reward pool while any address can claim only funds explicitly earmarked to it.

ASSET.description: ERC20 token distributed as protocol rewards.

REGISTRY.description: Registry used to resolve the canonical rollup and governance owner.

canonicalRollup.description: Current canonical rollup, which can claim from both the implicit reward pool and funds earmarked to it.

registryOwner.description: Current owner of the linked Registry, resolved by the RewardDistributor at call time.

totalEarmarkedBalance.description: Total reward balance reserved for specific recipients rather than the canonical rollup's implicit pool.

entries.name: ProtocolTreasury
entries.description: Holds the protocol's funds controlled by Governance. It acts as a timelocked executor for spending or relaying transactions approved by the DAO.

GOVERNANCE.description: Governance contract allowed to act through the treasury once the gate has opened.

ATP_REGISTRY.description: Registry controlling token unlocks for treasury-held AZTEC positions.

GATED_UNTIL.description: Earliest timestamp at which the treasury relay gate can open. The additional ATP and proposal-ordering conditions still apply.

getActivationTimestamp.description: ATP-derived cutoff timestamp. A Governance proposal relaying through the treasury must have been created after this cutoff.

entries.name: BaseStaker
entries.description: Implementation registered by the ATP Registry for upgradeable staker proxies that manage locked AZTEC positions.

pendingOwner.description: Address nominated to become the AZTEC token owner.

entries.name: GSE
entries.description: Central staking manager independent of Rollup implementations. Sequencers deposit stake here through their chosen Rollup contract. Their stake is then transferred to the Governance contract and activated for voting. The GSE tracks which rollup instance validators are securing, and gives them an option to automatically move to the latest Rollup version.

proofOfPossessionGasLimit.description: Gas cap for verifying a new validator's BLS proof of possession. The owner can set it too low for valid keys, which blocks new validator deposits.

ASSET.description: ERC20 token staked by validators and used for governance voting power.

getGovernance.description: One-time configured contract receiving voting power from staked validators.

getLatestRollup.description: Latest rollup registered in the GSE. Validators assigned to the bonus instance follow this address.

entries.name: AztecTokenPositionRegistry_ProtocolTreasury
entries.description: AZTEC token-position Registry referenced by the ProtocolTreasury for its activation cutoff and by other ecosystem vesting contracts.

pendingOwner.description: Address nominated to become the ATP Registry owner.

getUnlockStartTime.description: Start of the global AZTEC unlock schedule. The owner can only move it earlier.

getExecuteAllowedAt.description: Base execution-eligibility timestamp used by contracts that reference this Registry. The owner can only move it earlier.

getStakerImplementation.description: Registered upgradeable staker implementations by version. Implementations only need to expose the required UUPS compatibility identifier.

getRevoker.description: Address used by ATP positions as the revocation authority.

getRevokerOperator.description: Optional operator allowed to perform revocation-related actions on behalf of the revoker.
